"Modern Day Cowboy" is the debut single by American rock band Tesla, from the band's debut studio album, Mechanical Resonance.
The song's lyrics make references to criminals such as Billy the Kid and Al Capone, until the final verse, which references Cold War tensions between the United States and the Soviet Union.

Music video
A music video was produced for the song, which shows Nikola Tesla playing films in an abandoned movie theater.
Mechanical Resonance is the debut studio album by the American hard rock band Tesla.
It was released on December 8, 1986, by Geffen Records.
